title: FraudGuard: fraud pipeline
description: Transfers, quick-scan and deep-scan verdicts, risk tiers, latency, queue lag and errors.

panels.title: Transfers / s
panels.description: POST /transactions accepted by transaction-service (all outcomes).

panels.title: Fraud-flag rate
panels.description: Share of quick-scan verdicts that flag the transfer for deep-scan.

panels.title: Deep-scan traffic
panels.description: Share of new transfers sent to deep-scan review (flagged, or quick-scan unavailable).

panels.title: quick-scan p95
panels.description: Model scoring time, p95. SLO: 20 ms (contract §4).

panels.title: Waiting for deep-scan
panels.description: Ready messages in transactions.flagged (deep-scan scales at 20 per pod).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules currently firing (list at the bottom).

panels.title: Transfers by quick-scan decision
panels.description: APPROVED: not flagged, settled immediately (tier LOW). UNDER_REVIEW: sent to deep-scan.

panels.title: Fraud-flag rate and deep-scan traffic
panels.description: Fraud-flag rate: quick-scan verdicts that flag. Deep-scan traffic: transfers sent to review (also when quick-scan times out or fails).

panels.title: Risk-tier distribution (time range)
panels.description: Final risk tier of the transfers in the selected time range: LOW from quick-scan (never flagged), and deep-scan's verdicts for flagged transfers.

panels.title: Deep-scan verdicts by risk tier
panels.description: Flagged transfers scored by deep-scan (XGBoost), per tier.

panels.title: Mitigation actions
panels.description: Actions applied by alerting-service per risk tier (config/tierActions.json).

panels.title: quick-scan scoring (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Isolation Forest scoring time inside the service, excluding HTTP. Dashed line: the 20 ms SLO.

panels.title: deep-scan scoring (p50 / p95)
panels.description: XGBoost scoring time inside the service. Dashed line: the 20 ms budget.

panels.title: Transfer API (p50 / p95)
panels.description: POST /transactions in transaction-service: validation, MongoDB, the quick-scan call and settlement. The quick-scan call includes the network (timeout 300 ms).

panels.title: RabbitMQ queue lag (ready messages)
panels.description: Messages waiting for a consumer. transactions.flagged drives deep-scan's autoscaler.

panels.title: Time to verdict (p50 / p95)
panels.description: deep-scan: from the transaction.flagged event to its acknowledged score. alerting: from the scored event to the applied mitigation.

panels.title: Consumer outcomes
panels.description: Deliveries handled per consumer: ok, retry (delayed), requeued, dead_lettered.

panels.title: 5xx error rate by service
panels.description: Share of API requests answered with 5xx (health checks excluded). Alert: above 5% for 5 min.

panels.title: Responses by status (API services)
panels.description: All API responses per status code. 4xx are client errors (validation, 409 replays, 423 frozen).

panels.title: quick-scan calls from transaction-service
panels.description: ok / flagged, or timeout / error (those transfers go to review).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alert rules in infra/monitoring/alert-rules.yaml that are firing now.

panels.title: Models in service
panels.description: Model versions loaded from the MLflow registry by each scan service.

targets.expr: max by (app_kubernetes_io_name, name, version, alias, source) (model_version_info)
